yadi iyaṃ saṃsāracakrikā kalpanāmātram yadi ca brahmaiva tattvato'sti tarhi tathā
kimiti medhāpratibhākauśalaśāliṣvapi mahājaneṣu ko'pi na paśyati tatra ko heturiti
cettadanapekṣā tadviruddhabhogaiśvaryādyabhiniveśaśca heturityāha -
kriyāviśeṣeti

bhogaiśvaryaprasaktasya kārāgṛhadārḍhyāyeva deharakṣaṇāya vṛthānarthāya
ca prayāsaṃ paramapuruṣārthopekṣāṃ cātyantānucitāṃ dṛṣṭvā tamanuśocati
- ādhīti
prāk prastutāṃ dāśūrākhyāyikāṃ śuśrūṣū rāmaḥ pṛcchati - dāśūreti
viṣayasukhārthā saṃsāracakrikā vastuśūnyā iti yattvayoktaṃ tatkiṃ kīdṛśam
sasyaiḥ saṃkaṭā nibiḍitāḥ sīmāntā grāmasīmāvadhayo yasmin

niśayā upabhuktairiva mlānotsṛṣṭaiḥ kusumairnīrandhrā viśikhā
manmathaśarā yasyāṃ tathāvidhā avaniryasmin
puṣpeṣu oghaiḥ pravāhaiḥ sphūrjanto dhvananto'nilā yasmin

yugagaṇaṃ ayanayugalātmakavatsaragaṇaṃ sukhaduḥkhādidvandvagaṇaṃ vā
bhuktvā anubhūya

daśayā caramabhāvavikāreṇa
grahadaśāviśeṣeṇa vā apanītaḥ pitā yasya daśabhiḥ prāṇairvā dehādapasṛtya
nītaḥ paralokāya pitā yasya

aharādīnāṃ patyādiṣu vā repho
vaktavyaḥ iti ratvam
na jñātamavaśyajñeyaṃ brahma yayā tathāvidhā buddhiryasya

tapastapsye iti saṃkalpadarśanāttaponantaraṃ tataḥ śīghraṃ
siddhyadarśanādayaṃ homasāhasārambha iti gamyate

samagrā glabhittayaḥ kaṇṭhadeśā vipramāṃsena jagdhena
bhasmatāṃ mā yāntu na prāpnuvantviti saṃcintyetyanvayaḥ

adhigatena prāptenābhimatena
vareṇa prayuktenānanamaṇḍaladyutibhareṇa sa dāśūraḥ śaśinamambujaṃ ca
jahāsetyutprekṣā
